phases.title: Phase 1: Discovery
phases.strategy:
This app has not been assessed yet. A discovery phase is required to build a baseline before the refactor plan can be written.

Discovery checklist:
- Business ownership confirmation (is this system truly orphaned?)
- Attack-surface validation (are reported CVEs actually exploitable?)
- Downstream consumer audit (any scheduled job still hits the DB?)
- Data archival plan signed off by compliance

Known blockers:
- Legacy vendor has veto rights on decommission decisions
- Business owner contact is ambiguous (no clear RACI)
phases.rollback: Discovery phases are non-destructive. If scope changes during discovery, update the decision file and re-run the planner.
phases.rationale: Database has been inactive for ~2.5 years (zero transactional volume since 2023-03-15). Vendor recommends retirement. Team requires dual validation before decommission: (1) confirm exploits are not actually reachable through the operator UI, (2) confirm no business process still depends on the engine. Default to refactor if either validation fails.

Team requires dual validation before decommission: (1) confirm exploits are not actually reachable through the operator UI, (2) confirm no business process still depends on the engine. Default to refactor if either validation fails. The app-03 application contains 4 modules (2,218 lines of code, 102 known vulnerabilities). NexusForge proposes a 1-phase strangler decomposition covering discovery. Total estimated effort: 6 engineer-days (~1 working weeks for a single engineer, or ~1 weeks for a 4-engineer team working in parallel). Each phase is independently deployable and reversible — no big-bang cut-over.
